item.title: Charleston County libraries, offices opening at noon on Monday, Feb. 2
item.description: Due to potential travel impacts from the recent severe winter weather, all Charleston County Public Library (CCPL) branches and offices will open at 12 pm on Monday, Feb. 2. All book drops/material returns will also open at this time.

item.title: Dorchester County Residents Urged to Remain Cautious of Icy Roads on Monday
item.description: Dorchester County Emergency Management officials continue to monitor weather conditions and work closely with the National Weather Services and local partners to monitor the weather and road conditions.

item.title: South Carolina Aquarium to Open at Noon on Monday, Feb. 2
item.description: Due to road conditions resulting from winter weather, the Aquarium is closed today, Sunday, February 1. The Aquarium will reopen at noon tomorrow, Monday, February 2.

item.title: Charleston County Parks to Remain Closed on Feb. 2
item.description: Charleston County Park and Recreation Commission parks and facilities will remain closed on Monday morning, Feb. 2, for staff to conduct assessments.

item.title: Charleston County Provides Fourth Winter Weather Update
item.description: Charleston County Provides Fourth Winter Weather Update

item.title: City of Charleston Offices and Facilities to Open at Noon Monday
item.description: As the City of Charleston continues to monitor weather conditions and forecasts calling for freezing temperatures, city offices and facilities will delay opening until noon on Monday.

item.title: New Pro Football League to Launch in 2027, Bringing Team to Charleston
item.description: The ApexPro Football League, a new professional American football league, announced that its inaugural season will kick off in spring 2027, with Charleston named as one of the league’s founding cities.

item.title: Epstein Files Release Includes 2014 Email Mentioning Dinner with "Southern Charm Cast"
item.description: The Charleston-based reality TV show Southern Charm was mentioned in the newly released batch of Jeffrey Epstein files made public by the U.S. Department of Justice on Friday, Jan. 30, 2026.

item.title: Waffle House to Offer Candlelit Valentine’s Day Dinners at Charleston-Area Locations
item.description: This Valentine’s Day, more than 200 Waffle House restaurants across 22 states — including locations in South Carolina — will once again offer reservation-only, candlelit Valentine’s dinners complete with white tablecloths and romantic music.

item.title: South Carolina Falls to Orlando, 6-1
item.description: The South Carolina Stingrays dropped the second game of a three-game road trip to the Orlando Solar Bears, 6-1, on Sunday afternoon at the Kia Center.
